steps.stdout:
Install the integration for the target tool

Usage: tokf hook install [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --global             Install globally instead of project-local
      --timing             Show how long filtering took
      --no-filter          Skip filtering, pass output through raw
      --tool <TOOL>        Target tool to install hook for (default: claude-code) [default: claude-code] [possible values: claude-code, opencode, codex, gemini-cli, cursor, cline, windsurf, copilot, aider]
      --path <PATH>        Path to the tokf binary to embed in generated scripts. Defaults to bare "tokf" (relies on PATH at runtime)
  -v, --verbose            Show filter resolution details
      --no-cache           Bypass the binary config cache for this invocation
      --no-context         Skip creating TOKF.md context file and CLAUDE.md reference
      --no-mask-exit-code  Disable exit-code masking. By default tokf exits 0 and prepends "Error: Exit code N" to output when the underlying command fails. This flag restores real exit-code propagation
      --preserve-color     Preserve ANSI color codes in filtered output. Internally strips ANSI for pattern matching but restores original colored lines in the result. Note: this is not `--color=always/never/auto` — it controls passthrough of the child command's existing ANSI codes through the filter pipeline [env: TOKF_PRESERVE_COLOR=]
      --otel-export        Export metrics via OpenTelemetry OTLP (requires --features otel)
  -h, --help               Print help
